pint.linePrev: Then some child came, you never asked for her to come
pint.line: She drank a pint of your rum
pint.lineNext: And later when you told me
stanza: The beach was empty but for one
Now you were lying in the sun
Then some child came, you never asked for her to come
She drank a pint of your rum
And later when you told me
You said she was a bore
That I never knew some of those secrets of yours

pint.linePrev: Who reach for anything they can to keep from goin' home
pint.line: Standin' in the corner, Casey drinks his pint of bitter
pint.lineNext: Never glancing in the mirror at the people passing by
stanza: Standin' in the corner, Casey drinks his pint of bitter
Never glancing in the mirror at the people passing by
Then he stumbles as he's leaving and he wonders if the reason
Is the beer that's in his belly or the tear that's in his eye
